aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:846.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The stagehand is responsible for performing all setup before, during, and after events which includes, but is not limited to, assembling and disassembling production equipment on stage. In addition, the stagehand will work closely with and assist carpenters with scenery build, installation, video, sound and light production Essential Functions Responsible for assembling and setting up at the beginning of the scene (i.e. props, microphones, musical instruments, scenery, etc), disassembling and removing equipment at the end of the scene in addition to cleaning up the stage and backstage area after performances. Load and unload equipment from trucks and set up equipment according to stage design while ensuring safety requirements are met. Assist carpenters with scenery build and installation of stage maintenance, construct and paint set pieces, move and rearrange furniture. Work closely with electricians and lighting assistants with maintenance of video, sound, and light production. Ensure operations of systems are functioning properly. beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:0b.title: Growth Lead
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:0b.description: ABOUT BEACON SOFTWARE Beacon Software is a permanent capital holding company which acquires and grows essential businesses. We are a profitable Series C firm that combines great technologists, operators and M&A professionals to accelerate the scale of the ambition of the dozens of businesses we own and operate. We are supported by capital from tier-1 venture capital, crossover, and endowment investors as well as the founders of the leading technology companies from the past decade. We are growing our team in Toronto, San Francisco, and New York. Apply below. You’ll be joining Beacon’s Acceleration team: a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists. We work closely with portfolio companies to solve problems, create and implement playbooks, and build new features and products. ABOUT THE ROLE Beacon Software buys businesses. You get to grow them. Specifically, you’ll design and run go-to-market experiments for a pod of 3-4 companies we’ve acquired in a particular industry (education, industrials, parks & rec, etc). This can take any shape: you might launch ads, cross-sell into other portfolio companies, game plan a conference, scrape high-intent lead lists, write copy, or vibe-code a dashboard. To put it another way, you’ll be a fractional head of growth, with an eye towards systems and playbooks that generalize across portfolio companies. We’re looking for an animal who can go into a business, ask the right questions with little context, launch experiments, and drive revenue. Basically, we’re looking for The Wolf https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOZB6mNqhuA, but for growth. WHY WOULD YOU WANT THIS ROLE? - Get a first-person view into the world of private equity, rollups, and AI. - Access proprietary learnings about vertical SaaS businesses in a variety of industries. - Work with a team of former YC founders, growth leaders, and execs at Silicon Valley’s fastest-growing companies (Instacart, AngelList, Retool, and more). - Have loads of control and autonomy over what you work on. - Be artsy AND sciencey. - Like writing copy and brainstorming video ideas? You get to do that. - Like reading investment memos and deeply understanding businesses? You get to do that, too. - Ample LLM token budget. - Meaningful equity in a hyperscaler that’s already profitable. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES - Asher https://www.linkedin.com/in/akingabramson/: Former cofounder of Demand Curve (YC S19). Has grown multiple startups to millions in annual revenue. - Safwaan https://www.linkedin.com/in/safwaan/: Former EIR & investor at Founders Inc., former Chief of Staff to a well-known entrepreneur - Brent https://www.linkedin.com/in/brent-jensen/: Former growth @Together Software (YC S19) & Roadmunk, both companies acquired for 8-figure sums. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Meet with your pod leader and portfolio company GMs, marrying product direction with user learnings to brainstorm growth experiments. - Prioritize, build, and launch experiments that meaningfully drive revenue. - Identify and optimize growth loops at portfolio companies. - Track and improve conversion at every major step of the marketing funnel. - Build systems (e.g., playbooks, Claude skills, mini-products) that less technical GMs and portfolio company employees can use to run GTM experiments themselves. - Hire other great growth people. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Former founders and growth marketers/GTM engineers with a track record of cracking growth channels and loops, ideally in B2B SaaS. - Strong growth fundamentals: prioritizing channels, breaking down funnels, developing ICPs, automating prospecting and leadgen, copywriting, CRO, etc. - Clear, concise writing. - Comfort saying no to the wrong priorities. - Enough vibe-coding chops to be dangerous, but not a man-with-a-hammer. - Software engineering or finance background is a plus, but not required. colibrigroup-colibrigroup:lever:8338f734.description: Position Overview: The Senior Product Manager owns the full strategy, roadmap, and business performance for Colibri’s Professional Development suite and AI Professional Development product lines. Operating as a mature individual contributor, this role translates senior-level direction into execution while driving measurable customer and financial outcomes across the entire product lifecycle — from content ideation and production through delivery, learner impact, and long-term value. You will combine deep customer insight, instructional design expertise, and AI-native thinking to build high-impact, scalable learning experiences that advance real estate professionals’ careers in an AI-driven market.
responsibilities: Own end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for the Professional Development suite and AI Professional Development offerings, with clear accountability for business results (enrollment, revenue, margin, retention, and learner value).
Lead AI-driven product innovation: translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, outcome-oriented learning experiences that are not just conceptual but tool-driven and learner-trusted.
Define and iterate on customer problems, navigate ambiguity, bring clarity to the problem space, and make confident product decisions that deliver meaningful business impact.
Push value across the full product lifecycle — content ideation, production, delivery, and continuous improvement — while elevating instructional design and learner experience.
Own P&L outcomes for the portfolio, including revenue growth, pricing strategy, margin performance, and key metrics such as enrollment, completion, NPS, repeat purchase, and long-term retention.
Master customer signals: build continuous feedback loops, analyze behavioral data and learner insights, and use them to refine strategy and unlock new growth opportunities.
Co-own go-to-market success with marketing, growth, sales, and delivery teams — shaping positioning, packaging, and launch readiness.
Influence without authority across Product, Technology, Content, Marketing, and Delivery functions to align on priorities and deliver scalable results.
Evaluate AI education services for potential acquisition or build (buy-versus-build decisions) and integrate advanced AI tools (including Claude with Model Context Protocol) into workflows.
Ensure responsible, ethical, and effective use of AI in education products, with strong emphasis on quality, reliability, scalability, and learner trust.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4f6d8393-8d74-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Web Scraping Engineer - Global Team based in India. This is a fully remote engineering opportunity focused on building reliable, scalable web data extraction systems. You will design, refactor, and maintain robust web scrapers that support critical business insights and customer-facing products. The role involves solving complex challenges around dynamic websites, browser rendering, session management, and anti-bot protections. You will collaborate with analysts and technical stakeholders to ensure high-quality, resilient data pipelines. As part of a growing engineering function, you will have meaningful influence over tooling, processes, and technical best practices. The role offers flexibility while working primarily within an 11 AM–8 PM IST schedule. Design, build, refactor, and maintain robust web scraping solutions, improving reliability, maintainability, performance, and scalability. Apply clean coding practices, modular architecture, code reviews, and sustainable engineering approaches across scraping projects. Implement advanced scraping techniques involving cookies, headers, user-agent rotation, proxies, fingerprinting, session management, and dynamic content handling. Navigate complex DOM structures and browser-rendered experiences while developing resilient data extraction workflows. Partner with analysts and other stakeholders to understand requirements, align scraping targets, and maintain high standards of data quality. Create monitoring, logging, metrics, and alerting solutions to identify scraper failures and performance issues quickly. Troubleshoot bottlenecks, availability issues, and scaling challenges while proactively improving scraper efficiency and resilience. Recommend new tools, methodologies, and technologies that strengthen web data extraction capabilities. Document solutions and provide guidance to internal stakeholders on effective use of scraped data. Stay current with evolving web technologies, bot-detection techniques, and innovative approaches to data extraction. Requirements 3+ years of professional experience working with web scraping frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, or Puppeteer. Strong understanding of HTTP, RESTful APIs, HTML parsing, browser rendering, and TLS/SSL mechanics. Hands-on expertise with advanced fingerprinting and evasion techniques, including browser fingerprint spoofing and request-signature manipulation. Deep experience managing cookies, headers, session states, and proxy rotation, including residential and data-center proxies. Experience developing or maintaining logging, monitoring, metrics, and alerting systems for high-availability applications. Strong troubleshooting and analytical abilities, with a focus on optimizing scraping solutions for reliability, efficiency, and scalability. Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and enthusiasm for solving complex technical problems. Ability to work collaboratively in a distributed, cross-functional environment and proactively identify opportunities for improvement. Benefits Fully remote position based in India, with standard working hours of 11 AM–8 PM IST and flexibility around working hours. Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. Paid vacation time and parental leave. Team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues in a distributed environment. Learning reimbursement to support continuous professional development. Career growth based on impact, skill development, ownership, and contribution rather than tenure or office presence. A collaborative culture built around learning, self-improvement, respect, trust, and meaningful technical ownership. Inclusive equal-opportunity workplace committed to supporting diverse perspectives and backgrounds. How Job

Our partner is looking for a Sr. Engineering Manager - Incentive Compensation Ops. based in United States. This is a senior engineering leadership opportunity focused on one of the most widely used areas of a modern incentive compensation platform. You will lead a team responsible for critical experiences including payouts, reporting, inquiries, statements, and other operational workflows. A central part of the role is transforming these experiences into AI-native products that reduce manual work and accelerate issue resolution. You will own engineering delivery, reliability, security, scalability, and business outcomes across your team's portfolio. Working closely with Product, Design, Platform Engineering, Sales, Support, and Customer Success, you will shape both near-term priorities and long-term strategy. You will also hire, mentor, and develop engineers while helping build the next generation of engineering leadership. This role is ideal for a technically strong, people-focused leader who thrives in remote-first environments and enjoys turning complex operational challenges into intelligent products. southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:4611bde4.description: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. ABOUT THE ROLE Render is looking for a Developer Community Lead to grow our community and engagement with developers across the platforms where they spend their time: X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Discord. You will be the public face of Render in these communities, building relationships with developers, creating content that sparks conversation, and turning Render's technical wins into stories the developer community wants to share.
